If you’re worried that markets are crashing, crisis is looming, and the PM has already advised us not to buy gold, scrap foreign holidays, work from home and save fuel for a year — relax.
After a mega roadshow in Jamnagar with a convoy big enough to cause its own traffic advisory, Modi ji is right now in Somnath praying for all of us. Not for jobs, growth or purchasing power — but for us to finally get some sense to understand that austerity is only for us,ordinary Indians.
Because clearly, the “save fuel” rule does not apply to the fleet of helicopters, chartered aircraft, SPG convoys and 50 plus-car roadshow moving across Gujarat. In 12 hours, 3 mega road shows in Gujarat, including two lined up today in #Somnath and #Vadodara .
And before bhakts get emotional —all ordinary Indians, please remember: Modi ji’s planes and convoys do not run on petrol or diesel. They are non-biological like him. They run on water. You can add hypocrisy & Godi media to it. Otherwise all is perfect and we are the Super Power. 
#PMInGujarat #NarendraModi

The Filipinos Do Not Yield (FDNY) Movement, along with various groups, hold a lightning protest in front of the Chinese Embassy along Sen. Gil Puyat Avenue in Makati City on Monday, May 11.

The protesters condemned the continued harassment, intimidation, and aggressive presence of Chinese ships in the West Philippine Sea, as well as China’s statement that the Philippines is “playing with fire” because of its alliances and preparations for self-defense. Protesters also held placards and burned a cardboard replica of a Chinese Coast Guard ship to express their anger. 

📸: Mark Balmores/MB
